_comment: Last-known-good Google review snapshot, refreshed automatically by src/lib/reviewStats.mjs on any build that reaches /api/reviews.php. Real Google reviews only - never hand-write entries here.

reviews.text: Had an amazing experience with Rahim! He was very knowledgeable and personable. I was in and out of the door, with 2 programmed keys, in less than 20 minutes!
Fantastic service and very thorough!!!! Highly recommend
​Fast and friendly service, I was in and out in ten minutes with exactly what I needed. Highly recommend Armstrong Locksmith!

Armstrong Locksmith was so helpful, kind and efficient when I came in after both of my car key fobs broke. They helped fix one of my key fobs and then cut me a new manual key and made sure to test everything twice to make sure it worked. I’d recommend them to anyone who needs a reliable locksmith!
